column1: # Docs registry: the single source for doc word budgets and for which Markdown
# the doc rules cover. Read by the docs-check lane (devtools/internal/checks/docs.go).
# The rules: docs/quality-gates.md ("Doc rules"). Words are whitespace-separated
# tokens. Raising a budget, or adding or widening an exempt, ephemeral,
# budget-only or set row, loosens a gate: it needs the operator's agreement. AGENTS.md and
# README.md are the entrypoints and need no index row.
#   budget     <doc|*>  <words>             a doc's limit; `*` is the default
#   set        <name>   <words>  <members>  combined limit of docs loaded together;
#                                           members are comma-separated docs or `dir/` prefixes
#   exempt     <prefix>                     Markdown there is not a doc (no budget, header or index row);
#   ephemeral  <prefix>                     exempt from every rule, and no file outside it cites a file in it
#   budget-only <prefix>                    Markdown there is not a doc (no header, index row or path
#                                           checks) but keeps a word budget: its own row or the default;
#                                           an ephemeral prefix inside it stays rule-free
# Read at the start of every session: AGENTS.md plus its "Always load" list.
